mcqs.question: According to the comparison of dairy-sector competitiveness, what was the farmgate price of cow milk in India for milk with 3.5% fat and 8.5% SNF?
mcqs.explanation: The farmgate price of cow milk in India was ₹34 per litre for milk with 3.5% fat and 8.5% SNF. ₹36.7 per litre was the corresponding figure for the US, while ₹55.6 per litre was the figure for Europe.
